title: RLHF Workflow: From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Pearson correlation coefficient between the reward model scores and the character lengths of generated responses to measure the preference for longer outputs, and conducting ablation studies by incorporating a length penalty into the reward function.
Randomizing the order of candidate responses during data formatting to prevent the preference model from disproportionately favoring the response presented first (e.g., RESPONSE A).
